column1: > Current state of every patch. Source of truth for "where are we";
> DECISIONS.md is the source of truth for "why".
> CTC round 1 results are against anchor d6b40b789381601440e4ce2cc1164cd57e8c3c7d
> the bit-exact ones. Bar is the Complexity-to-Efficiency ratio

column13: notes
Only patch passing the bar on BOTH classes. Modest but genuine. A2 ratio 25.2 also meets the Speed-3 bar; A1 23.6 does not, so scope it to Speed 4

Only patch with real magnitude. Fails bar 20 on both, A2 binds. Needs A2 BD cut 1.29%->0.926% (-28%) at constant speed. A1 needs only -6.7%. Worse ratio on A2 despite HIGHER speedup => damage compounds temporally
Real speedup but BD cost 4-6x too high. Gap to bar 20 is too large to tune
Near-zero speedup on A1, real BD cost on both
Slower on A1. A2 'infinite ratio' is a rounding artifact of a -0.01% BD, not a win
Slower on A1, flat on A2. Confirms the round-1 paired data, which showed it as a slowdown while round-robin called it noise
Slower on BOTH classes. Negative BD is meaningless without a speedup
Bit-exactness CONFIRMED by CTC: exactly +0.00% on every metric. But SLOWER on A1 4K. Zero risk, zero benefit
Bit-exactness CONFIRMED. Slowest of the three on A1. One large arena appears to cost more in locality at 4K than the many small allocations it replaced
Bit-exactness CONFIRMED, and the memo key is correct. But slower on both: at 4K the lookup is paid on every call and the hit rate does not repay it
The three together are slower than baseline. Confirms they are individually and jointly worthless as speed features
Dominated by i06. Backing i06 out implies the other nine give only ~7.4%/~6.7% speed for ~1.75%/~2.16% BD, a ratio of ~4.2/~3.1. The combination is i06 plus ballast
Bar at Speed 3 is 25; ratio 8.1/7.6

Best ratio of any combination (12.1) and still far under the Speed-2 bar of 30. Note the speedup rises at slower presets (30.7% at S2 vs 20.3% at S4) for near-identical BD, so the heuristics prune redundancy that only exists in deeper searches
Estimated: speedups compound multiplicatively, BD additively. Barely better than i06 alone because i09 is small. This is the arm the next round should test, NOT all-10

Supersedes i09. Measurement now lazy and after the cheap checks (i09 was -0.27% i.e. SLOWER on A1 at Speed 3: overhead paid where it could never fire). MARGIN 4->2 to claim speed i09 left unused at only +0.11% BD. Sweep with -DTX_PART_STATIONARITY_MARGIN=N

Supersedes i06 and i06b. Adds resolution-scaled min block size: all 4 presets show worse BD AND higher speedup at 1080p than 4K. Floor 16->32 at 1080p, 16 unchanged at 4K, so it acts on the class needing -28% and not the one needing -6.7%. Frame gate narrowed to key frames only
Best shipping candidate so far. Clears the bar on 4K; A2 still fails, carried there by i06c

Supersedes i09b. MARGIN 2->1. Loosening was ratio-positive at both measured points (23.6->26.7 A1, 25.2->51.0 A2) so this tests the next step. A1 binds with 33% headroom. Fallback needs no patch edit: -DTX_PART_STATIONARITY_MARGIN=2 restores the 09b operating point exactly

Supersedes 06c. 06c cut A2 speed 66% for a 64% BD cut - proportional, so the ratio got WORSE (14.4->13.5). A1 floor never changed at 4K, so A1 -57% speed came from the variance floor + frame gate. 06d removes the frame gate (it disabled pruning on intra frames, where a SOURCE profile is most valid) and relaxes the floor for low-value ext partitions only. RISK: 06c passes A1 at 20.9, thin margin - keep 06c as fallback arm

Built from marginal ratios, not a new hypothesis. Variance floor DELETED (cost 2.04% A1 speed for 0.00% BD - worthless). Frame gate RESTORED (marginal 12.8, under the bar, so removing those prunes helps; 06d was wrong to drop it). Block-size floor REVERSED: raising it to 32 on A2 removed prunes worth marginal 24.2, i.e. the GOOD ones - so floor stays 16 and anisotropy now scales UP with block size (x2 at 32-63, x4 at 64+) because a wrong prune on 128x128 commits 64x the area of one on 16x16
